sources.title: BagIt (RFC 8493)

sources.title: Python zipfile
sources.relevance: The existing Python standard library writes and reads stored ZIP entries. Delivery Packager adds bounded allowlists, declarations and approval binding.
sources.reuse: Imported from the caller runtime; no CPython implementation is vendored. Python runtime has its own license.
